dispatch: Send remote scheduling instructions to control the EMS running logic.
extra: For EMS temporary debugging instructions, do not limit specific functions and specific parameters, the directive name and parameters by the EMS itself defined
hp_power_en: Heat pump power control. ON turns the heat pump on, OFF turns it off
remote_control.close_mos: Remotely closes MOS for battery discharging
remote_control.forced_charge: Force to fully charge the battery
remote_control.forced_work: Force the battery to enter work mode (Parallel mode)
remote_control.service_ready: Force SOC of the battery to charge or discharge to 50% (T5 Only)
remote_control.voltage_calibration: Calibrate the sample battery voltage from the inverter terminal
resume: Force the EMS upload regular operation data within a specified time period
send_energy_data_en: Enable or disable minute-level operating data. Use parameter 1 to enable, 0 to disable
set_config: Synchronize the stored system configuration to the EMS
sync_time: Force the EMS to synchronize with the server (simultaneously sends the time zone setting in the system configuration)
upload_data: Upload local history data for the EMS specified date
upload_log: Upload the  EMS log file of a specified date to the server
